scratch/design.md item 20 is accepted and replaces the kickoff assumption about cohorts: --cohort is optional on launch/queue; omitted, a pass that needs one gets the experiment's next automatically numbered cohort, so rerunning the same command launches a later stage. Pick a spelling that cannot be read as a run address; --parallel and --max-usd stay per cohort, so per pass, and the docs and pass output say so. Explicit --cohort NAME unchanged.
